> Clean by construction: a role description written by the hiring manager.

We are hiring one backend engineer for the billing team. The work is mostly
invoicing, proration and the reconciliation job that nobody enjoys and everyone
depends on.

You would own that job. It runs nightly, it touches money, and when it is wrong
somebody notices within a day. If that sounds like a burden rather than a clear
brief, this is not the role — and that is a real filter, not modesty.

Salary band is published in the listing. We do not negotiate it upward for
people who ask and downward for people who do not.
